meera (oncall): paging — automated alert: canary rollout v2.3.1 shows p95 latency x3 and elevated 5xxs on production-serving; kernel-fallback spike on slice A. Can anyone confirm?
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: INC-2026-324 created — severity: P1 — paging meera (oncall) — /page oncall
sre_talia: looking now. I can see kernel-selector thrash and batch-queue depth climbs. Prefetch/batching combination seems to push microbatch window from ~8ms to ~120ms under tail load.
mike (deploy): fyi I rolled the canary from 10% -> 50% over last hour. If batching path is culprit I can flip the feature flag.
alyssa (runtime): confirmed — kernel fallback events correlate with the canary hosts running the new-batching kernel. Also seeing increased async queue stalls and KV cache churn. Recommend kill-switch first.
meera (oncall): jordan, any customer reports yet? we need impact triage.
jordan (support): two customers opened tickets about slow responses, one saw transient 502s. CS triage: elevated latency, no data corruption. I've flagged for priority updates.
mike (deploy): executing kill-switch for feature 'new-batching' now: `POST /api/flags/new-batching {"enabled":false}`
deploy-bot: killflag 'new-batching' set to OFF by mike (deploy) at 18:14 UTC :white_check_mark:
alyssa (runtime): metrics updating — p95 on canary slice down ~45% within 90s. Kernel-fallback rate dropping.
sre_talia: still small KV cache thrash residuals; I'll recycle canary pods in slice A to clear caches.
meera (oncall): if stabilization isn't clean in 10m we should rollback the canary to v2.3.0 for slice A. agree?
mike (deploy): agreed. I'm starting a partial rollback for slice A to v2.3.0 now: `deploy rollback --slice A --to v2.3.0`
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by mike (deploy). slice A -> v2.3.0. progress: 25%...
jordan (support): posted a brief customer update: "We're investigating a performance regression introduced in a limited release; mitigation in progress. No data loss. We'll update in 15 minutes."
sre_talia: rollback reached 100% on slice A; kernel-fallback events and microbatch latency returned to baseline. Throughput normalizing.
alyssa (runtime): verifying traces — cold-start KV misses are back to expected levels, batch-window back to ~10ms. Looks stable.
meera (oncall): keeping paging open for 30m to monitor, then we'll close unless anything else pops. Action items: 1) block merging of batching optimizer until postmortem + repro; 2) add a canary guard that enforces per-slice latency SLOs before increasing percent; 3) run longer perf tests with KV churn scenarios.
jordan (support): CS to send follow-up to impacted customers once we confirm stable.
cust-escalation: noted. one customer asked for ETA; will relay "monitoring, mitigation applied, ETA 30m for final update".
oncall-bot: INC-2026-324 status updated -> mitigated by meera (oncall). :white_check_mark:
meera (oncall): thanks all — nice quick coordination. I'll start the postmortem draft and assign owners for the 3 action items. :thumbsup:
